display_long_description:
BlastZone brings the classic charm of an old-school shooting gallery straight into VR—bright lights, fast action, and that “just one more try” feeling. Whether you're a seasoned sharpshooter or brand-new to VR, you’ll jump in instantly and have a blast.

Choose from different stylized guns, each with unique handling and abilities. Level them up as you play to boost your score. Then step into themed stages—like a whimsical barn, or a retro carnival gallery—each packed with moving targets, tricky setups, and fun surprises. Some targets are worth big points… others you really don’t want to hit!

BlastZone is built for quick, satisfying sessions: start a match, shoot, score, repeat. Climb the global leaderboard, challenge your friends, and push your accuracy skills to the limit. Whether you're chasing high scores or just looking for some light-hearted arcade fun, this is your personal shooting range—anytime you want.

Ready? Grab your weapon, hit the play button, and let’s rock!
